claim: Composa's intent-enum pipeline is an architectural mismatch for compositional personal-assistant requests.
A native per-session tool loop can resolve references and compose retrieval, reading, mutation, and reply in one turn.
Durable Object session state and D1 domain memory should remain separate.
Cloudflare Think is the best current substrate for Composa v2, provided its experimental dependency is isolated.
Safety and ownership must be enforced in tool code, not entrusted to the system prompt.
Structured lifecycle and tool observability is required to diagnose production failures without guessing.
Composa can retain the OpenClaw control pattern while omitting gateway, shell, browser, nodes, plugins, and multi-agent breadth.
